text: {"question":"What evidence in the conclusions supports the claim that the variable‑curvature model is the only one exhibiting a decelerated phase near redshift z = 0?","reference_answer":"The conclusions note that, according to the AIC and BIC analysis, the Ωk‑ΛCDM model is preferred overall, but among alternatives the PEDE and GEDE models remain competitive.
